physicalNotes: Radius 3.4 +/- 0.23 solar radii from Computed here, not printed by a paper: 3.4 +/- 0.23 solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.02 +/- 0.07 mas of Hanbury Brown, Davis & Allen (1974), MNRAS 167, 121 (the Narrabri intensity interferometer; Code, Davis, Bless & Hanbury Brown (1976), ApJ 203, 417, Table 1, and the JMDC) and the Hipparcos parallax 32.29 +/- 0.21 mas (van Leeuwen 2007, XHIP) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/167.1.121): 2,365,380 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 14050 +/- 540 K from Code, Davis, Bless & Hanbury Brown (1976), ApJ 203, 417, HD 209952: effective temperature 14050 +/- 540 K (Table 6), from the measured angular diameter and the star's flux from the ultraviolet to the infrared (https://doi.org/10.1086/154093). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
